exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Want someone to do something for you".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
Verb てもらいたい (～te moraitai)
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb てもらいたい (～te moraitai) matches "Want someone to do something for you".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb てもらいたい (～te moraitai).
exercises.explanation: Expresses wanting someone else to do something for you.
